description: Every code-enumerable theory \(T\) has a primitive-recursive Boolean certificate relation \(E\) whose existentially certified axiom set is exactly \(T\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.enumerable_theory_certificates.{u_1, u_2} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  (S : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.EffectiveSignature L) (T : L.Theory)
  (hT : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.CodeEnumerable S T) :
  ∃ E, Primrec₂ E ∧ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.theory S E = T
